properties.name: Re-measured after phase 7 PR 4: computed links leave the fixture's 118 cut-off clusters at 118, because the hub's pins are wired to nothing in the hub; wired, 119 -> 101
properties.statement: MEASURED 2026-10-22 on release builds through the --call door, PR 3's fixture shape (hub + 15 exports, 3,196 nodes, 4,731 edges; p7pr2/cost/members2, pins sourced https://example.org/mN): UnthreadedCluster findings 118 of 1,910 before (PR 3 binary) and 118 of 1,895 after (PR 4 binary): 104 by_design and 14 now by_pair hub x member. The 15 computed links are all pin_names_graph_id (the members are slices of one design with distinct pin sources, so no shared file); OrphanNode 377 -> 362, the hub's 15 pins absorbed. CAUSE (root-cause steps walked; no precedent found by search_design across the hub's 19 designs): a pin link is drawn FROM the pin node to the member's anchor (the node of its design network with the most traceability edges), and the fixture hub's pins are wired to nothing in the hub, so each pin threads only itself to its member: {pin + member body} is still an island beside the largest body, now filed under the pair. Discriminating measurement: the same hub with its 15 pins wired to one component (cmp:hub DEPENDS_ON each dep:mN): 119 -> 101. Of those 101, 86 are each member's own islands (the members composed alone, one store each: 3,8,5,1,6,8,0,9,21,1,7,6,4,7,0), and 15 are memb06's 8 and memb14's 7, which those two component-less members' own checks suppress alone ('at genesis the islands are the plan', structure_declared false) and the combined graph, holding components, reports. So with wired pins the composition-made class goes to 0 apart from the genesis case; with unwired pins it is unchanged in number. Not established: how hxm_program's own hub wires its pins. Decision status not changed (Anthony's choice (a) stands; the note sentence ships in PR 4). Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_019Xbw6PG9mXJiU2Sb421fnq
